files.description: Measured PhysX trajectory against the analytic oracle with the judge's pass lines drawn on (free fall + contact gate, bounce apex gate, energy gate).
The agent loop replayed (each iteration a real grade.sh verdict) plus the per-mutant gate matrix (kill rate 10/10 = 100%).
42 s, 1920×1080 @ 30 fps: the drop, the bounce, a sped-up real selftest.sh run, the verdict and the kill matrix. Machine-gated with cookbook/tools/video_gate.py; blind-judged in media/REVIEW.json.
The planned storyboard as a filled-in slot table (what fills the frame, the source data/command for each shot, the caption text) written before the video is cut; the video is judged against it.
The two blind judge verdicts on media/demo.mp4 (see Review panel in DEMO-STANDARD.md).
For each file: what it shows, the command that produced it, the source data file, sha256.
